description: Inputs for Robotics inference: one observation of a robot, returning the policy's next action chunk
title: RoboticsInput

images.description: Camera images keyed by camera name (the policy's camera names when known), each a base64-encoded PNG or JPEG or a URL

seed.description: Seed for the policy's own random draws (flow-matching or diffusion noise), for reproducible actions

num_actions.description: Number of actions of the chunk to return (defaults to the policy's chunk size)
